title: Introduction to the Bash Shell
description:
A complete shell-fluency course: 18 lessons (Parts I–V, orientation → automation on a cluster), each executed for real under the bash kernel in CI (GNU/bash-5, Ubuntu target) — a failing check cell blocks the site. Carries a 65-command registry with per-lesson command cards and the Compendium Scriptorum.

Read the course at ramador.me/bash-primer-public. This archive captures the runnable, solution-stripped public mirror. Text is licensed CC BY 4.0; code cells are MIT.
